# Notion Style

Notion Style matches the minimal Notion aesthetic across Obsidian with refined typography, a wider 1080px reading width and headings matched pixel for pixel between editor and reading view. The sidebar and file tree, code blocks with GitHub light and dark palettes, language labels and a copy button, callouts, tables and interactive elements are restyled for light and dark modes on desktop and mobile.

![Notion Style screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chonnz/obsidian-notion-style/HEAD/light.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Notion Style"
    author: "chonnz"
    repo:   "chonnz/obsidian-notion-style"
    slug:   "notion-style"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/notion-style"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/chonnz/obsidian-notion-style"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chonnz/obsidian-notion-style/HEAD/light.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Match Notion's clean, minimal aesthetic across Obsidian with refined typography, a wider 1080px reading width, and pixel-matched headings between editor and reading view. Restyle sidebar/file tree, code blocks (GitHub light/dark palettes, language labels, copy button), callouts, tables and interactive elements for light and dark modes on desktop and mobile."
}
```
